adds.title: Cyprus Civil Union Law 2015 - House of Representatives vote
adds.summary: On 26 November 2015 Cyprus's House passed civil-unions legislation by 39 votes in favour, 12 against and 3 abstentions, granting legal recognition outside marriage and religion to both same-sex and opposite-sex life partners under statutory legislation termed 'civil unions' rather than contractual 'civil partnership', without extending to child adoption or gay marriage.

adds.title: Cyprus Parliament vote criminalizing conversion therapy - 25 May 2023
adds.summary: On 25 May 2023 Cyprus's House Plenum voted to criminalise conversion therapies.
